experience.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
highlights: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express for the OICT TechStore e-commerce platform, handling product listings, cart management, and order processing.
Built and structured a MongoDB database with Mongoose schemas and relationships for users, products, orders, and categories.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization with bcrypt password hashing, securing all protected routes.
Deployed the application to a cloud server, configured environment variables, and set up a production-ready Express server.
